name: APP_ENV
description: Environment name: staging or production

name: PROVIDERS_MODE
description: Always live in deployed environments

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: Server log level

name: AWS_REGION
description: Region of every regional resource

name: API_DOMAIN
description: Host name Caddy serves the API on

name: MCP_DOMAIN
description: Host name Caddy serves the MCP server on

name: CDN_DOMAIN
description: Host name of the CloudFront media distribution

name: ACME_EMAIL
description: Contact address for Let's Encrypt certificates

name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
description: Comma-separated https origins of the web app

name: TURNSTILE_EXPECTED_HOSTNAMES
description: Comma-separated host names Turnstile tokens must come from

name: STORAGE_BUCKET
description: Private media bucket

name: STORAGE_REGION
description: Region of the media bucket

name: STORAGE_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
description: false for AWS S3

name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL
description: Browser-reachable storage origin used to sign presigned URLs when it differs from the internal endpoint; leave unset on AWS

name: BACKUP_BUCKET
description: Bucket for Redis backups

name: IMAGE_REPOSITORY_API
description: ECR repository URL of motionile-api

name: IMAGE_REPOSITORY_WORKER
description: ECR repository URL of motionile-worker

name: ECR_REGISTRY
description: ECR registry host used for docker login

name: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP
description: Log group the awslogs driver writes container logs to

name: SES_CONFIGURATION_SET
description: SES configuration set used for every message

name: EMAIL_FROM_DOMAIN
description: Verified SES sending domain

name: DATABASE_STATEMENT_CACHE_SIZE
description: 0 behind a transaction-mode pooler such as Neon's

name: CLOUDFRONT_KEY_PAIR_ID
description: ID of the CloudFront public key; present once the CDN is enabled; used from Phase 8 and required when MEDIA_DELIVERY_MODE=cloudfront

name: DATABASE_URL
description: Pooled PostgreSQL URL used by the application, postgresql://...

name: DATABASE_DIRECT_URL
description: Direct PostgreSQL URL used by migrations and workers, postgresql://...

name: REDIS_PASSWORD
description: Password of the Compose Redis service

name: SECURITY_PAGINATION_SECRET
description: At least 32 random characters that sign pagination cursors

name: CATALOG_REVALIDATION_SECRET
description: At least 32 random characters shared by catalog revalidation tasks and the web endpoint

name: SHARE_INTERNAL_SECRET
description: At least 32 random characters shared by the API and the web server so server-rendered share pages skip the per-IP limit and the view counter

name: ENCRYPTION_KEYS
description: JSON map of key version to base64 32-byte AES-GCM key, for example {"1":"<base64>"}

name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key of this environment

name: CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY
description: PEM RSA private key stored base64-encoded that signs CloudFront cookies and URLs; used from Phase 8 and required when MEDIA_DELIVERY_MODE=cloudfront

name: AUTH_JWT_KEYS
description: JSON map of key ID to base64 32-byte Ed25519 private seed

name: AUTH_JWT_CURRENT_KID
description: ID of the active signing key

name: AUTH_JWT_ISSUER
description: HTTPS API issuer

name: AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
description: Access token audience

name: AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN
description: Shared registrable cookie domain prefixed with a dot

name: AUTH_WEB_ORIGIN
description: HTTPS web origin also present in CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

name: AUTH_API_ORIGIN
description: HTTPS public API origin for provider callbacks

name: AUTH_OTP_PEPPER
description: At least 32 random characters for OTP HMAC

name: AUTH_CSRF_SECRET
description: At least 32 random characters for session-bound CSRF

name: AUTH_HIBP_ENABLED
description: true to check new passwords with the range API

name: NOTIFICATIONS_EMAIL_BACKEND
description: ses in deployed environments

name: NOTIFICATIONS_SENDER
description: Verified SES sender address

name: NOTIFICATIONS_SES_REGION
description: SES region ap-south-1

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_TOKEN
description: Meta system-user access token

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
description: Meta business phone number ID

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE
description: Approved authentication template name

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_NOTICE_TEMPLATE
description: Approved security utility template with one body parameter

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_LANGUAGE
description: Approved template language

name: NOTIFICATIONS_WHATSAPP_API_VERSION
description: Pinned supported Graph API version

name: AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
description: GOOGLE OAuth client id

name: AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
description: GOOGLE OAuth client secret

name: AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
description: GITHUB OAuth client id

name: AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
description: GITHUB OAuth client secret

name: AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
description: MICROSOFT OAuth client id

name: AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
description: MICROSOFT OAuth client secret

name: BILLING_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
description: Razorpay API key ID of this environment

name: BILLING_RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
description: Razorpay API key secret of this environment

name: BILLING_RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Secret configured on the Razorpay webhook that signs webhook bodies

name: BILLING_RAZORPAY_API_BASE_URL
description: HTTPS origin of the Razorpay API; defaults to https://api.razorpay.com

name: BILLING_ORDER_EXPIRY_SECONDS
description: Seconds before an unpaid order expires; defaults to 7200

name: BILLING_SUBSCRIPTION_TOTAL_COUNT
description: Billing cycles requested for every new subscription; defaults to 120

name: BILLING_EXPIRY_REMINDER_LEAD_DAYS
description: Days before expiry that the credits expiring soon notice is queued; defaults to 7

name: BILLING_RESERVATION_TTL_SECONDS
description: Seconds an active credit reservation is held before it is released; defaults to 3600

name: BILLING_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS
description: Processing attempts per webhook event before it stays failed; defaults to 10

name: BILLING_RECONCILIATION_PENDING_AFTER_SECONDS
description: Age in seconds after which a pending order is reconciled with Razorpay; defaults to 1800

name: BILLING_REPORT_STORAGE_PREFIX
description: Object key prefix of reconciliation reports; defaults to billing/reconciliation

name: MEDIA_DELIVERY_MODE
description: cloudfront behind the CDN or presigned for storage URLs without CloudFront

name: MEDIA_COOKIE_DOMAIN
description: Domain of the CloudFront signed cookies; defaults to AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN

name: MEDIA_COOKIE_TTL_SECONDS
description: Lifetime of the CloudFront signed cookies in seconds; defaults to 3600 and may not exceed 3600

name: MEDIA_SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS
description: Lifetime of presigned and signed media URLs in seconds; defaults to 900 and may not exceed 3600

name: AUDIO_TTS_PROVIDER
description: Speech synthesis provider: elevenlabs or openai; defaults to elevenlabs

name: AUDIO_TRANSCRIBER
description: Transcription provider for alignment and consent checks: elevenlabs or openai; defaults to elevenlabs

name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
description: ElevenLabs API key; required while ElevenLabs is the TTS provider or the transcriber

name: ELEVENLABS_API_BASE_URL
description: HTTPS origin of the ElevenLabs API; defaults to https://api.elevenlabs.io

name: ELEVENLABS_TTS_MODEL
description: ElevenLabs synthesis model; defaults to eleven_multilingual_v2

name: ELEVENLABS_STT_MODEL
description: ElevenLabs transcription model; defaults to scribe_v1

name: ELEVENLABS_OUTPUT_FORMAT
description: ElevenLabs audio output format; defaults to mp3_44100_128

name: ELEVENLABS_COST_MICROS_PER_1K_CHARS
description: Micro-dollars recorded per 1000 synthesized characters; defaults to 180000

name: OPENAI_API_KEY
description: OpenAI API key; used for skill embeddings and while OpenAI is the TTS provider or the transcriber

name: OPENAI_API_BASE_URL
description: HTTPS origin of the OpenAI API; defaults to https://api.openai.com

name: OPENAI_TTS_MODEL
description: OpenAI synthesis model; defaults to gpt-4o-mini-tts

name: OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL
description: OpenAI transcription model; defaults to whisper-1

name: OPENAI_COST_MICROS_PER_1K_CHARS
description: Micro-dollars recorded per 1000 synthesized characters; defaults to 15000

name: AI_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
description: Anthropic API key for the generation pipeline models

name: AI_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY
description: Langfuse public key for pipeline traces

name: AI_LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
description: Langfuse secret key for pipeline traces

name: AI_LANGFUSE_HOST
description: HTTPS origin of Langfuse; defaults to https://cloud.langfuse.com

name: AI_LANGFUSE_PROJECT_ID
description: Langfuse project ID used to build trace links in the admin console

name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
description: Embedding model for skill routing; defaults to text-embedding-3-small

name: EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
description: Embedding vector size read by the migration; defaults to 1536

name: AI_FIXTURES_DIRECTORY
description: Directory of the scripted LLM fixtures used when PROVIDERS_MODE is fake; defaults to the repository fixtures

name: RENDER_FPS
description: Render frame rate from 24 to 60; defaults to 30

name: RENDER_X264_CRF
description: x264 constant rate factor from 0 to 51; defaults to 20

name: RENDER_X264_PRESET
description: x264 speed preset; defaults to veryfast

name: RENDER_PARALLEL_PAGES
description: Browser pages capturing chunks in parallel from 1 to 8; defaults to the CPU count capped at 8

name: RENDER_CHUNK_SECONDS
description: Seconds of video per capture chunk from 1 to 30; defaults to 5

name: RENDER_SCENE_PADDING_MS
description: Silence between narrated scenes in milliseconds; defaults to 400

name: RENDER_TAIL_MS
description: Milliseconds the final frame is held after the narration; defaults to 1000

name: RENDER_MAX_DURATION_MS
description: Maximum narration duration in milliseconds up to 120000; defaults to 120000

name: RENDER_POSTER_MS
description: Poster frame time in milliseconds; defaults to 2000

name: RENDER_PAGE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Seconds the sandbox waits for a composition to load; defaults to 15

name: RENDER_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Seconds the sandbox waits for the composition ready signal; defaults to 15

name: RENDER_FRAME_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Seconds the sandbox waits for one frame; defaults to 10

name: RENDER_STAGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Wall-clock limit per render stage in seconds; defaults to 1800

name: RENDER_STALL_SECONDS
description: Seconds without a progress update before a render counts as stalled; defaults to 900

name: RENDER_MIN_FREE_DISK_MB
description: Free disk space in megabytes required before capture; defaults to 2048

name: RENDER_BROWSER_MEMORY_MB
description: JavaScript heap limit of the render browser in megabytes; defaults to 768

name: RENDER_WORK_DIRECTORY
description: Parent directory of per-render temporary directories; defaults to the system temporary directory

name: RENDER_GOLDEN_DIRECTORY
description: Directory of the golden compositions; defaults to /app/golden in the worker image

name: RENDER_FFMPEG_PATH
description: ffmpeg executable; defaults to ffmpeg

name: RENDER_FFPROBE_PATH
description: ffprobe executable; defaults to ffprobe

name: VOICES_CONSENT_MATCH_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum similarity from 0.5 to 1 between the consent sentence and its transcript; defaults to 0.85

name: VOICES_SAMPLE_MIN_TOTAL_SECONDS
description: Minimum combined voice sample duration in seconds; defaults to 30

name: VOICES_SAMPLE_MAX_TOTAL_SECONDS
description: Maximum combined voice sample duration in seconds; defaults to 300

name: VOICES_SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES
description: Maximum size in bytes of one uploaded voice file; defaults to 26214400

name: VOICES_CONSENT_MIN_SECONDS
description: Minimum consent recording duration in seconds; defaults to 3

name: VOICES_CONSENT_MAX_SECONDS
description: Maximum consent recording duration in seconds; defaults to 30

name: VOICES_ATTEMPT_TTL_SECONDS
description: Lifetime of a voice clone attempt in seconds; defaults to 3600 and may not exceed 3600
